Author: DeadlyDeathAngel
Name: Auto Party Finder
Punchline: Recruit members with saved Party Finder conditions and auto-relist.
Description:
Opens a Recruit Members window with the same Party Finder fields as the game: party type, duty category, objective, newbie welcome, comment, and average item level.

Saved conditions are reused the next time you recruit. With Auto put up PF enabled, the listing is posted again after 59 minutes or if Party Finder ends for any reason.

Commands:
/apf — open the recruiter
/apf recruit — post with saved conditions
/apf stop — stop auto-relisting
